description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions for clients and government organizations. The company is seeking an entry-level Java Developer to design, develop, test, debug, and support software applications throughout the full development life cycle. The role also involves analyzing requirements, evaluating technologies, managing user requirements, and troubleshooting code.
Entry-level application developer for business software, coding, testing, debugging, and requirements analysis

Responsibilities:
• Designs, develop documents, tests and debugs new and existing software systems and/or applications
• Participates in full development life cycle including requirements analysis and design
• Participates in software design meetings and analyzes user needs to determine technical requirements
• Consults with end user to prototype, refine, test and debug programs to meet needs
• Creates technical specifications based on conceptual design and stated business requirements
• Identifies and evaluates new technologies for implementation
• Minimizes risk, prepares for risk mitigation, keeps project on track
• Manages user requirements; provides timely project updates
• Analyzes codes to find causes of errors and revise programs as needed

Requirements:
• 1+ years of working experience as a Java developer
• Excellent programing & troubleshooting skills
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Skills:
• 1+ years of working experience as a Java developer
• Excellent programing & troubleshooting skills
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Pay: $63K/yr - $82K/yr
